ValidationRule.description: Approved Completed projects cannot be created by a session-less context (GETSESSIONID empty) or carry a line break in the name.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISNEW(), Is_Approved__c, ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Completed'), OR(LEN(GETSESSIONID()) = 0, CONTAINS(Name, BR())) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Approved, completed projects cannot be created from a session-less context.
